items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I did a lot of the Dick Clark production shows as well.

ctx.x: Usually they were like on the side. Carol Burnett, there was the audience, here is the audience here and here’s the stage here, and the band was right here, abutting onto the stage but on the side of the audience behind a glass. You could see the audience but it had glass up there to keep the sound, some of the sound out. And on the Dean Martin Show, which was a very popular show, it was similarly set up but you couldn’t see the audience because it was like drapes in between you and the audience. They were all…
Did you guys ever have trouble keeping a straight face on those kind of things?
